verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain is a first-party SCA tool that flags dependency vulnerability findings as reachable when code in the codebase matches the vulnerability definition. That gives security engineers a reachability signal to prioritize dependency alerts. Missing for 10: documentation of how reachable findings are filtered, sorted or prioritized in triage; details on how deep the reachability analysis goes and which languages it covers; independent or hands-on corroboration that reachability cuts dependency-alert noise.
